title: The Twelve Zodia Bound in the Sphere
description: All the zodiacal archons are by substance mutually hostile falsities-from-evil drawn out of the Five Worlds of Darkness and bound in the sphere by the Great Artisan, two signs to each world. Five wandering stars, two Anabibazons (Dry-One and Moist-One as Father and Mother of all the rest), seven makers of evil bound in tree and flesh; Sun and Moon are reckoned among them only by the necessity of the redemptive economy, not belonging to this dark dominion.
